description: This file contains the implementation of the SystemTargetBasedMembershipTable class and related classes for managing membership tables within Orleans runtime, including methods for initialization, reading, updating, and logging membership data.

classes.name: SystemTargetBasedMembershipTable
classes.description: Implements IMembershipTable, managing membership data via system targets within Orleans runtime.

classes.name: MembershipTableSystemTarget
classes.description: A system target that manages an in-memory membership table, supporting lifecycle participation and logging.

methods.name: InitializeMembershipTable
methods.description: Initializes the membership table, setting up the system target.

methods.name: GetMembershipTable
methods.description: Retrieves the system target for the membership table, ensuring primary silo readiness.

methods.name: WaitForTableGrainToInit
methods.description: Waits for the membership table grain to initialize, with retries and logging.

methods.name: DeleteMembershipTableEntries
methods.description: Deletes all entries in the membership table for a given cluster ID.

methods.name: ReadRow
methods.description: Reads a specific membership row identified by SiloAddress.

methods.name: UpdateIAmAlive
methods.description: Updates the IAmAlive status of a membership entry.

methods.name: CleanupDefunctSiloEntries
methods.description: Removes defunct silo entries older than a specified date.
